content:
{
  "root_cause": "The accessible-autocomplete widget does not reset the underlying select's value when the user enters a value that does not match any option (including blank/whitespace), causing the previously selected value to be submitted.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a MutationObserver that watches the DOM and ensures that if the combobox input's trimmed value does not correspond to any option, the underlying select's value is set to empty string.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "app.js",
      "sha256": "c0cd5c1ac1020b4313357444a74cdf86be52c9c19abbcf2686cfb28fdc7531b2",
      "before": "for(const id of ['shipping-country','billing-country'])accessibleAutocomplete.enhanceSelectElement({selectElement:document.getElementById(id)});\ndocument.getElementById('preferences').addEventListener('submit',event=>event.preventDefault());",
      "after": "for(const id of ['shipping-country','billing-country'])accessibleAutocomplete.enhanceSelectElement({selectElement:document.getElementById(id)});\ndocument.getElementById('preferences').addEventListener('submit',event=>event.preventDefault());\n\n// Ensure that typing an unrecognized or blank value clears the underlying select.\nconst observer = new MutationObserver(() => {\n  document.querySelectorAll('#shipping-country, #billing-country').forEach(select => {\n    // Find the associated combobox input (created by accessible-autocomplete)\n    const input = select.parentElement.querySelector('input[role=\"combobox\"]');\n    if (!input) return;\n    const val = input.value.trim();\n    let matched = false;\n    for (const option of select.options) {\n      if (option.value === val || option.textContent.trim() === val) {\n        matched = true;\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n    if (!matched && select.value !== '') {\n      select.value = '';\n    }\n  });\n});\nobserver.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "No adverse effect; keyboard and mouse selection of listed items continues to work because those actions set validChoiceMade true and the observer will not alter the select when a match exists. Screen readers will observe the select reflecting the current visible value.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential interference if the library itself updates the select asynchronously causing double assignment.",
    "Observer performance impact if the DOM changes frequently.",
    "Risk if the library changes DOM structure and our query fails to locate the input."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Entering a recognized country sets the select to its code.",
    "Entering an unrecognized string or whitespace leaves the select empty.",
    "Pressing Save after such entry results in an empty submitted value.",
    "Normal selection via arrow keys and Enter still works and updates the select correctly.",
    "The observer does not cause infinite loops or stale values."
  ]
}
